evals.prompt: Write an ADR documenting our decision to use Redis pub/sub for cross-service event distribution instead of polling or direct HTTP callbacks.
evals.expected_output: Lists existing ADRs to find the next sequential number, creates a new ADR file at docs/architecture/adr/NNN-redis-pubsub-cross-service.md with all required sections (Context, Decision, Rationale, Alternatives, Consequences), status Accepted, mentions the realtime.md rule file.
expectations: Listed existing ADRs in docs/architecture/adr/ to determine next sequential number
Created file at docs/architecture/adr/ with correct NNN-slug.md naming
ADR includes Context section explaining the problem
ADR includes Decision section clearly stating what was chosen
ADR includes Alternatives Considered with at least polling and direct HTTP
ADR includes Consequences section with trade-offs
ADR references or mentions the realtime.md rule file

evals.prompt: Document our architecture decision to use db-per-tenant isolation rather than shared tables with a tenant_id column.
evals.expected_output: Finds next ADR number, creates docs/architecture/adr/NNN-db-per-tenant.md with full template, status Accepted, references database.md rule file, explains rationale (isolation, compliance, independent schema evolution) and trade-offs (more Postgres connections, migration complexity).
expectations: Found next sequential ADR number from existing files
Created file at correct path in docs/architecture/adr/
ADR has all required sections (Context, Decision, Rationale, Alternatives, Consequences)
ADR references database.md rule file in Implementation Notes
Rationale includes isolation and/or compliance benefits
Consequences include the trade-off of more DB connections or migration complexity
